Sarvaank Associates advised lead investor Blue Ashva Capital on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Ankita Singh (Managing Partner) and Yash Vardhan Singh (Partner), with support from Sanchita Gupta (Senior Associate), Dipanjana Das (Senior Associate) and Jayant Jindal (Associate). Ankita Singh Kepler Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based space technology company focused on building advanced space infrastructure and mission operations capabilities. The company develops an integrated technology stack spanning satellite avionics, ground infrastructure, mission operations and space-based intelligence, with a focus on next-generation Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) technologies. items.summary: Madhumitha, a 26-year-old nurse, had stepped out of the clinic for breakfast on Thursday, September 17, when her husband chased her down, attacked her with a butcher knife and poured acid on her. The attack took place in full public view around 9.15 am near Narayana Clinic in Bengaluru’s JP Nagar. Madhumitha is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital. She is in a critical condition, according to the police. Madhumitha, who hails from Kolkata, has been working at the clinic for around one-and-a-half years. According to sources, Madhumitha and Venkatesh were married in 2023 and had been living separately for the past year due to family disputes. The alleged attack is suspected to have followed marital differences between the couple. Venkatesh had arrived at the clinic on a motorcycle carrying a knife, a machete and acid. Madhumitha had reportedly stepped out of the clinic to have breakfast at around 9.15 am when he followed her. She reached the hospital parking area while shouting for help, where the accused repeatedly attacked her with a machete and another sharp weapon before pouring floor-cleaning acid on her.
